title: Hopscotch
text:
Hopscotch is a traditional game. Children draw a grid on the ground with chalk. They jump on one foot from square to square.

Each child has a small stone. They throw the stone into a square. The player with the most points wins.

questions.text: What do the children draw on the ground?
Why do the children probably need chalk?
What kind of player probably wins the game?
options: The player who gets the least points
The player with the most points

vocabulary.definition: passed down from one generation to the next
soft colored material used for drawing on the ground or a board
a small hard piece of rock
units used to count the score in a game

paragraph_translations: La rayuela es un juego tradicional. Los niños dibujan una cuadrícula en el suelo con tiza. Saltan con un pie de cuadro en cuadro.
Cada niño tiene una piedra pequeña. Lanzan la piedra a un cuadro. El jugador con más puntos gana.
